parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the interface. This parameter is based on ''ifAdminStatus'' from {{bibref|RFC2863}}.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The current operational state of the interface (see {{bibref|TR-181i2|Section 4.2.2}}). {{enum}} When {{param|Enable}} is {{false}} then {{param}} SHOULD normally be {{enum|Down}} (or {{enum|NotPresent}} or {{enum|Error}} if there is a fault condition on the interface). When {{param|Enable}} is changed to {{true}} then {{param}} SHOULD change to {{enum|Up}} if and only if the interface is able to transmit and receive network traffic; it SHOULD change to {{enum|Dormant}} if and only if the interface is operable but is waiting for external actions before it can transmit and receive network traffic (and subsequently change to {{enum|Up}} if still operable when the expected actions have completed); it SHOULD change to {{enum|LowerLayerDown}} if and only if the interface is prevented from entering the {{enum|Up}} state because one or more of the interfaces beneath it is down; it SHOULD remain in the {{enum|Error}} state if there is an error or other fault condition detected on the interface; it SHOULD remain in the {{enum|NotPresent}} state if the interface has missing (typically hardware) components; it SHOULD change to {{enum|Unknown}} if the state of the interface can not be determined for some reason. This parameter is based on ''ifOperStatus'' from {{bibref|RFC2863}}. Because the interface includes layer 1, the {{enum|LowerLayerDown}} value SHOULD never be used.

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.description: {{datatype|expand}}

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The textual name of the interface as assigned by the CPE.

parameters.name: LastChange
parameters.description: The accumulated time in {{units}} since the interface entered its current operational state.

parameters.name: LowerLayers
parameters.description: {{list}} {{reference|an interface object that is stacked immediately below this interface object}} See {{bibref|TR-181i2|Section 4.2.1}}. Note: Since {{object}} is a layer 1 interface, it is expected that {{param}} will not be used.

parameters.name: Upstream
parameters.description: Indicates whether the interface points towards the Internet ({{true}}) or towards End Devices ({{false}}). For example: * For an Internet Gateway Device, {{param}} will be {{true}} for all WAN interfaces and {{false}} for all LAN interfaces. * For a standalone WiFi Access Point that is connected via Ethernet to an Internet Gateway Device, {{param}} will be {{true}} for the Ethernet interface and {{false}} for the WiFi Radio interface. * For an End Device, {{param}} will be {{true}} for all interfaces.

parameters.name: MaxBitRate
parameters.description: The maximum upstream and downstream PHY bit rate supported by this interface (expressed in {{units}}).

parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: The MAC Address of the interface. Note: This is not necessarily the same as the Ethernet header source or destination MAC address, which is associated with the IP interface and is modeled via the {{param|##.Ethernet.Link.{i}.MACAddress}} parameter.

parameters.name: FirmwareVersion
parameters.description: This interface's firmware version.

parameters.name: NodeID
parameters.description: The Node ID of this interface.

parameters.name: IsMaster
parameters.description: Whether this interface is the HPNA network master.

parameters.name: Synced
parameters.description: Whether this interface is synchronized with the HPNA network master. If this interface is the HPNA network master, {{param}} MUST be {{true}}.

parameters.name: TotalSyncTime
parameters.description: Total time in {{units}} (since device reset) that this interface has been up and synchronized to the HPNA network master.

parameters.name: NetworkUtilization
parameters.description: Current HPNA network utilization (expressed in {{units}}).

parameters.name: PossibleConnectionTypes
parameters.description: {{list}} List items indicate the types of connections possible for this interface. {{enum}}

parameters.name: ConnectionType
parameters.description: {{list}} Connection type(s) for which the HPNA protocol is active.

parameters.name: PossibleSpectralModes
parameters.description: {{list}} List items indicate the spectral modes possible for this interface. {{enum}}

parameters.name: SpectralMode
parameters.description: Spectral mode for which the HPNA protocol is active.

parameters.name: MTU
parameters.description: Maximum Transmission Unit for this HPNA interface (expressed in {{units}}).

parameters.name: NoiseMargin
parameters.description: The desired noise margin for which the local HPNA interface has been configured (expressed in {{units}}).

parameters.name: DefaultNonLARQPER
parameters.description: The desired packet error rate for which the local HPNA interface has been configured (expressed in 1E-8, e.g. PER of 1.27E-6 will be presented as 127).

parameters.name: LARQEnable
parameters.description: Enable or disable the Limited Automatic Repeat Request (LARQ) mechanism.

parameters.name: MinMulticastRate
parameters.description: The minimum multicast (and broadcast) rate that can be negotiated on the HPNA network directly accessible via this interface (expressed in {{units}}).

parameters.name: NegMulticastRate
parameters.description: The negotiated multicast (and broadcast) rate on the HPNA network directly accessible via this interface (expressed in {{units}}).

parameters.name: MasterSelectionMode
parameters.description: Master selection mode. {{enum}}

parameters.name: AssociatedDeviceNumberOfEntries
parameters.description: {{numentries}} This is the number of HPNA nodes that are directly accessible via this interface.

object.description: HPNA interface table (a stackable interface object as described in {{bibref|TR-181i2|Section 4.2}}). Each table entry models the PHY and MAC levels of an HPNA interface {{bibref|G.9954}}.
